MQTT_SERVER_EGRESS
Description
This iRule event is triggered when an MQTT message is sent to
server-side. In case an MQTT message has large payload such as for
server PUBLISH message types, this event may trigger before entire
payload is sent. In that case, MQTT::collect may be used to obtain the
payload.
NOTE: This event is implemented only for Message Routing based MQTT
Sessions
